_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Disaster Preparedness Exercise Evaluation Report
summary: The Disaster Preparedness Exercise Evaluation Report documents locally conducted attack, major accident, and natural disaster response exercises so the government can evaluate their extent and content.
description_purpose: The evaluation report is used by the contractor to document locally conducted attack response exercises (ARE), major accident response exercises (MARE) and natural disaster response exercises (NDRE) as applicable. The report is used by the government to evaluate the extent and content of the exercise.
application_interrelationship: This data item description contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be by letter and in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain the following data:

children.title: Name of installation, date of exercise and type of exercise.
Details of the evaluation to include objectives, exercise situation, time of initiation, time of termination, and location.
Summary of findings and ratings for mandatory areas of evaluation for ARE, MARE and NDRE (List agency office of primary responsibility (OPR)).
Statement that each agency OPR with a finding will reply in writing within ten workdays stating specific action taken to correct deficiencies and estimated completion date.
Signature block of the installation exercise evaluation chief.
